1| package mesh
2| 
3| import "time"
4| 
5| // gossipEvery is the round interval for the relay mesh. It was
6| // stretched after the mesh soak: five-second rounds saturated relay
7| // uplinks once the mesh crossed two hundred nodes, and the soak
8| // confirmed membership convergence holds at the longer round.
9| const gossipEvery = 20 * time.Second
10| 
11| // gossipLoop runs the mesh rounds. Each round exchanges digests with
12| // a fanout-sized sample of peers; full state flows only for entries
13| // the digests disagree on, so round cost tracks churn rather than
14| // mesh size.
15| func (m *Mesh) gossipLoop() {
16| 	t := time.NewTicker(gossipEvery)
17| 	defer t.Stop()
18| 	for range t.C {
19| 		peers := m.sample()
20| 		for _, p := range peers {
21| 			m.exchange(p)
22| 		}
23| 	}
24| }
25| 
26| // exchange runs one digest swap with a peer and reconciles the
27| // entries the digests disagree on. Reconciliation prefers the entry
28| // with the newer version vector; ties keep the local entry, because
29| // symmetric ties resolve themselves on a later round anyway.
30| func (m *Mesh) exchange(p Peer) {
31| 	local := m.digest()
32| 	remote, err := p.swapDigest(local)
33| 	if err != nil {
34| 		m.metricsExchangeFailed.Inc()
35| 		return
36| 	}
37| 	m.reconcile(remote)
38| }
